### Andrea Gomez Vargas - Sociologist and Population Statistics Analyst

Andrea Gomez Vargas is a sociologist specializing in population and official statistics. She works at Argentina’s National Institute of Statistics and Censuses (INDEC), where she has experience in the production and analysis of population statistics, including work on the final results of Argentina’s 2022 Population, Household and Housing Census. She is the main author of ARcenso, an open-source R package initiated through the rOpenSci Champions Program. Her contributions to the project combine expertise in census data and statistical methodology with R package development, particularly in the identification, harmonization, validation, and documentation of historical census data.


### Emanuel Ciardullo - Statistician and Data Science Coordinator




**Selected public artifacts**: [ARcenso repository](https://github.com/SoyAndrea/arcenso/), [ARcenso documentation](https://soyandrea.github.io/arcenso/), [rOpenSci Champions blog](https://ropensci.org/blog/2026/08/10/analisis-demografico-con-arcenso/), [ARcenso outreach and presentations](https://soyandrea.github.io/conoce-arcenso.html).
